annotations.title: Refresh SSO token if it's expiring soon

description: Proactive SSO token check. If the cached token has fewer than `thresholdMinutes` left (default 10), this kicks off aws_login_start and returns the verification URL + code in one round-trip. If plenty of time remains, returns `status: 'ok'` with the minutes left. Use at the start of a multi-step AWS workflow to avoid mid-session expiry. `status: 'ok'` is a point-in-time reading of the cache, not a lease: nothing re-checks afterwards, so a token that lapses mid-workflow still surfaces as an sso_expired error from the next aws_call / aws_whoami. Raise `thresholdMinutes` to cover the expected length of the workflow rather than treating 'ok' as a guarantee.

profile.description: AWS profile configured for SSO. Defaults to $AWS_PROFILE or 'default'.

thresholdMinutes.description: Trigger refresh when the token has fewer than this many minutes left. Default 10.

name: aws_refresh_if_expiring_soon
